summary: Glowing Bear provides a web-based user interface designed to connect to the WeeChat IRC client. It runs on Node.js and allows you to access your ongoing chat sessions through a standard browser. The project is licenced under the GPL-3.0.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you already rely on WeeChat as your core IRC client and want a graphical browser interface to access it remotely.
watchOut: The codebase has infrequent recent releases, meaning you might encounter unresolved issues or a lack of modern web platform integration. It also relies entirely on an existing WeeChat backend to function.
deployNotes: You will typically need to run this behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely, and ensure proper network routing to your WeeChat relay port.
